name: learn-while-building
description: Ship real project work while building durable, project-grounded understanding.

interface.shortDescription: Ship the code. Keep the understanding.
interface.longDescription: Adds a calm learning layer to coding work: a clearly bounded 30-second brief, Quiet, Coach, and Deep modes, project-grounded Learning Diffs, gradual handback, delayed recall, private learning records, and optional offline lessons.
capabilities: A maximum 30-second learning brief with a fixed end boundary
Quiet, Coach, and Deep learning modes with gradual handback
Project-grounded Learning Diffs, open-response practice, delayed recall, and misconception tracking
Session-only, private-project, and shared-project privacy modes
Offline interactive lessons with accessible visual fallbacks
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $learn-while-building in Quiet mode. Begin meaningful updates with the maximum 30-second learning brief and its fixed end marker, then continue the normal project response.
